title: Bardo Rogue
subtitle: First Gate: rooms-as-data, a generated route, a town that remembers

timeline.text: The Bardo becomes a district. One 64x36 room of four floating islands - causeway, Forge, Shrine, Gate plaza - on a south-to-north pilgrimage line, bridges over starfield void, Seals in silhouette east and west, the Ferryman's pier moored at the south-west edge. Void cells are solid to the sim and transparent to the bake; the door-enter line is relative to the door's own row now. Matrix 100/100 both bots, pinned hashes unmoved.

Review round on PR 20: three P2s, all real. The Oath-Bound and the Warden had their heavy poise breaks suppressed by a rule that only knew the brute — the sim now says which bodies do not yield to a light. The plant latch resets where swing ids restart, and one shared promiseFrame() keeps the drawing on the same frame as the dust.

The elite keeps its shield. A flank light used to stagger the Oath-Bound, and staggerTicks outran the light chain, so one hit put the guard down and MEASURED 0% uptime for the rest of the fight. It now inherits the line shade's poise: 85%. COMMIT, FLANK and BURN are three answers again.
A refused toll still meets you in the Hall after a reload. The Unburied waits for the judge instead of the next fight. The death stele holds its own build line.

Two standing audits re-checked against HEAD: 51 claims, none false, 7 stale. The clip sampler can now play more than three drawings, the heavy's plant lands on the tick the dodge stops working, and the life crown stays on the body during Minos.
The pause card hides GIVE THE DESCENT BACK during a playtest, as the protocol always said it did. A no-dash bundle now replays as a no-dash run.
The Hall names THE HALL OF MINOS. The judge's plate samples wine, not the door. Acheron is 2 HOPLITES; the Antechamber is OATH-BOUND.
The toll, the Unburied, the verdict, and Settings still read as authored. No leftover on those four cards.
The Smith and a claimed vow keep their written case. Credits name the cast. The stall still ends on PAY.
BETWEEN BREATHS no longer advertises E EXPORT · I IMPORT. The keys stay in the harness.
Coming home names 2 KEPT, not THE BARDO over the footer. After the type ramp the map, the death stone, and DESCEND AGAIN still read.
The first fight no longer wears UNMARKED BLADE. The strip arrives when a vow or a coin does. Title and meeting still read after the type ramp.
After the door-flash lead, kite is 7/8 and naive is 0/8. Coming home is still unarmed. Do not retune the loss.
Minos's life is wine. The Hall no longer wears a gold door for a plate.
A light on the Oath-Bound stays copper. The disc no longer flashes as a gold door.
A mix is the names. Lethe no longer says 3 SHADES.
The Lampad's lock is wine. A pale ray the length of the cistern read as a shot.
The Kindly One meets you in the room. The 0.92 blackout is gone.
2 HOPLITES is the count. The four-dot rail under marks still on the floor is gone.
The door flash is the hold. Acheron no longer waits a second lead on an empty floor.
One Oath-Bound is a name. The empty pip rail no longer reads as a dead bar.
The judge's plate is his life. The veil is a notch, not a cut that empties the bar.
Minos names the slam before it locks. The Hall's dark no longer eats the tell.
Arrival is a wine pad on the floor. The dashed reticle is gone.
A ready Brand is three cuts, not three yellow plates over the head.
Judgment collects in ember. Cream stays off the ring and the stamp.
THE ACCOUNT's coin is brass. A caught word is white and ember, not a door.
A Kindly swing is ember and wine. Cream stays off the crescent.
The ferryman is owed for coin or a word. He does not sell.
The Unburied's memory stands for a breath. It does not buy.
Coming home asks DESCEND AGAIN. The tally sits with the verbs. DAMNED is gone.
Three marks and the collection ring stay Kindly fire. Gold stays the crossing.
The stall ends on PAY. BUY no longer sits under the ferryman.
The five-second strip is the plan. THE ACHERON GATE stays in the footer.
A meeting is a face and a vow. THE ACHERON GATE no longer sits under CLAIM.
The Hall dresses now. The scale sits west or east. Same wine, one poppy, a fight circle that stays bare.
Minos falls in wine. The verdict is SIX CHAMBERS. TWO KEPT — a sentence, not a clock.
WAKE THE ROOM uses the same left column. The first frame a browser shows is the living Bardo, not a card over the rack.
The title sits left. The veil thins. You can see the unarmed body and the rack while you read DESCEND.
Kite seeds 1–8 all come home in 45–59 s. Naive dies by 26 s in two or three chambers and still comes home. The sentence plays. A person has not sat down.
You wake without the blade. The authored idle no longer carries a sword in the Bardo. The rack is the ritual.
A primed step heats the blade. The chevron over the helmet is gone.
Coming home is a Bardo veil, not the cream strobe of a new chamber. A door lifts dark; a floor wears its own fog.
The one bed retunes with the floor. Acheron is thinner; the Hall is heavier. The tell band does not move.
A shade arrives in wine, not cream. THE ACCOUNT's ring is brass, not the door. The Empusa's body strobes wine-hot.
Minos's circle, veil, and fan are wine. Gold stays on the scale. Ember stays on a burning body.
The Empusa's lane is wine-dark. She chooses in wine and commits in wine-hot. Ember stays on a burning body, not on the floor she promised.
The Lampad's bolt and lock are wine-dark. Magenta is Hecate's. A dart you cut does not wear the veil.
A brazier tongue follows the floor. Acheron is cold river; Phlegethon is wine. Fire on a body stays ember.
The smear wears the vow. Kindly fire is ember; Hecate is veil. Cleaving Grace stays steel and only gets wider. A primed step heats the next cut.
The Oath-Bound's hoplon is bronze. Gold stays the crossing. A light that rings off the disc no longer wears the door's colour.
A burning shade wears a vertical ember vein. Brand keeps the diagonal cut. Burn does not grow a second pip row.
The key light follows the floor. An undressed Acheron brazier is cold river, not ember. A shut door on Styx is iron; the open door is still gold.
The air follows the floor. Acheron is cold river, the Landing is gold, Styx is iron, the Hall and Phlegethon are wine. Consecutive rooms no longer share one warm bed.
The title no longer says NONE RETURNED. A first death is 1 DESCENT · UNNAMED. Minos names you; coming home does not.
A meeting ends on CLAIM, or CLAIM · TURN when the Smith has been paid. A duo names THE KINDLY ONE · HECATE. The ferryman's extra meeting is WHAT THE LAST ONE PAID; the toll costs A LIFE, FOR GOOD.
The death stone is three sentences: A FALLEN HOPLITE TOOK YOU, AN UNMARKED BLADE, ONE CHAMBER IN. NOTHING NEW. The plan's last row dropped THEN — the names are the rest of the spine.
A coming Hoplite is a wine-dark pad on the floor, not a white reticle in the air. The strip says 2 HOPLITES.
The loop's door flash is the hold. Spawn marks are already drawing on Acheron when the floor is visible. The Antechamber's Oath-Bound lands on that clock: a light is bronze, a heavy is the answer.
A loop room no longer reprints its name as a second title. The footer already names the floor; you already pressed Descend.
Pause hushes the life plate. BETWEEN BREATHS is not five sockets sitting on the card.
Pause opens SETTINGS. MUSIC / SOUND / STILL THE ROOM are reachable mid-descent; a run does not have to die to go quiet.
The Antechamber no longer wears a Field poppy. Consecutive oath rooms half-recognize: a bronze lintel, or an iron court. The only poppy left is the one on Minos' scale.
Death no longer keeps UNMARKED BLADE · NO OBOLS on the stele. The stone already names the blade.
The death stone says RETURN. The loop no longer names R on the way home; stock scenarios still teach the key.
The Unburied's memory costs ONE KEPT, not ONE REMEMBRANCE. The town, the Smith, and the bank now share the same word.
The Smith asks for three of what the dead keep, and five of what you kept. He does not say remembrances.
The plan no longer says FIRE or ICE. Late doors read RIVER — the river's name is already on the row.
The verdict names what this descent banked, not the lifetime pile. 9 KEPT on a win after other runs; the home banner uses the same words.
Swim and the river collects as THE ACCOUNT — coin on the body, ACCOUNT on the strip, TAKEN BY THE ACCOUNT on the stone. Pause gives the descent back, not the attempt.
The plan no longer says NORTH or EAST. The doors read VEIL, BLADE, OATH — the compass was sitting on the five-second decision.
Leave him and he is THE UNBURIED in the Hall — wine on the body, UNBURIED on the strip, TAKEN BY THE UNBURIED on the stone. Not a fallen Hoplite.
Final Judgment holds a ring at the sim's own radius through hit-stop. The collection is a crowd, not a louder hit on one body.
A marked Hoplite wears the cut. Three gold pips count the sentence; the slash sits on the body, not in a HUD row.
A vow no longer says Brand or names the L key. Ashen Edge writes a mark; three is a sentence. The footer is CLAIM, or CLAIM · REFORGE.
The Oath-Bound holds a hoplon on the body, not a smile under the feet. The plan says VEIL, BLADE, OATH, JUDGE — not FIGHT, HARD, ELITE.
The Oath-Bound holds a plate, not a 1px smile. A light that lands on bronze lights the face it refused.
A meeting hides the life plate. The stall is a conversation, not five empty sockets under the ferryman.
The fight strip and Charon's bank say NO OBOLS and ONE OBOL, not 0 OBOLS.
Coming home says 1 DESCENT, not 1 ATTEMPTS, and does not put the sword back in an unarmed hand.
Phase two names the blow that landed. The circle's veil reads THE VEIL, not the circle that threw it.
Minos deaths name the sentence: THE CIRCLE, THE VEIL, or THE FAN. The Hall no longer subtitles itself the last chamber. The sound gate says WAKE THE ROOM.
Pause is BETWEEN BREATHS, not PAUSED. The rivers no longer wear Field poppies; the Antechamber no longer wears the ferry shore.
The judge arrives on the Oath-Bound's clock. The Hall no longer stands empty while his name sits on the banner; the refused toll still wades in after him.
The Hall dresses as a scale. Two pans at different heights, a short beam that does not cross the fight, wine light — not a stripe through the judge and not hell-orange.
A sixth spine. The ash march walks both rivers and never stops at the bank — no ferryman, no Unburied, no stall. The plan reads PHLEGETHON · COCYTUS · ELITE · MINOS.
A fifth spine. The Styx Gate is the first fight on one descent in five: a dash and a Hoplite, iron banks, not the Acheron ferry. Consecutive runs can miss the room that used to open every attempt.
Settings owns the mix. MUSIC and SOUND in eight steps, keyboard and pad. The room stills in the same words. A save without the new fields still comes back at full voice.
A fourth spine. The Phlegethon Ford is its own late fight — two Lampads on the banks, then a dash through the ash. Cocytus is no longer the only river after the stall.
The loop no longer writes ROOM CLEARED over the plan. Pause stills the room without a V. Coming home says what you kept, not the currency's name.
The third spine omits a chamber. Acheron stays the first fight. The Field is the fork: Lethe or the Reach, never both. The combine-verbs room is no longer the second door.
The title is three verbs. DESCEND, SETTINGS, CREDITS. The room can be stilled from the gate; the credits name who waits, not the toolchain.
The Smith names the one you left before he names the cup. The title says DESCEND, not PRESS ENTER.
A second spine. Half the descents put the stall after Cocytus. The plan reads COCYTUS · LANDING · ELITE · MINOS, and the next attempt can flip it.
Minos phase two recombines. After the veil, the circle throws the veil, the veil throws the fan, the fan plants the circle. The tells do not get shorter.
Pause is a breath, not a harness. Export/import and the keybind dump left the card. Offers say CLAIM, the stall says BUY, the bank says ANSWER. The loop no longer stamps WASD over the first swing.
The death card names the sword you built. Taken by, carried (the vows), reached — not a timer where the build should be.
The HUD names the dead of this realm. One body is an Oath-Bound, not LEFT 1. The loop no longer writes WAVE 1 or WALK NORTH over the plan.
The exits strip is a plan. After the next door it names the rest of the spine: landing or the Unburied, Cocytus, the elite, Minos.
The six chambers dress themselves. Cocytus weeps down the west wall; the Antechamber is a lintel, not the Acheron shore. Live descents swap same-kind floors so a room you know comes back half-new.
Six chambers on a path. After the landing: the Cocytus Reach, then the Antechamber where the Oath-Bound stands alone, then Minos. The cup that stays is already in the steel.
The anvil sells a cup that stays. Five Remembrances after the reforging: one more vessel in town and on every later descent. The stall's sip still dies with the attempt.
The Smith names the one you left on the bank. The town answers the Unburied once, then the anvil is the anvil again.
The Unburied. Half the landings are his mooring, not the stall. A coin, a memory, or you leave him — and he follows you to the judge.
Pause can send you home. RISE, or give the attempt back — confirm twice and the Bardo takes you. Remembrances bank; you do not have to die to leave.
Coming home names what you kept. If the anvil can be paid, the Bardo says so — you do not have to find the Smith to learn the town remembers.
The Smith stands west of the rack. Three Remembrances buy one offer reforging per descent. Town remembers; the next run plays differently.
Landing shop: obols from kills and clears, Remembrances banked on death or victory, Charon sells a sip / a cup / a word. Town meta shows what you kept. Smith reroll is next.

Greek dress on the four existing builders (Acheron silt/reeds, Lethe grate-water, Asphodel poppies, Landing prow+pole, Minos beam). Collision unchanged. Open-door glow is canon gold, not hell-orange. Gauntlet still parked.
First Gate spine: rooms-as-data, exits-phase route strip, startRun route install, node-boundary checkpoint (schema 3). Overlay verified at the Acheron fork. Gauntlet still parked for authored art.
Task 4 sim half: startRun installs a generated first-gate route (fixed fill matches the loop fixture). Map hashed. Overlay still the parent.
Revision 3 audit at 6852aa0. Loop proven. 512 tests. Kite 6/8, naive 0/8. Next: rooms-as-data + exits map. Gauntlet stays parked pending authored art.
Goal armed. Inventoryed the Kenney vertical slice.
Baseline captured. First piece: The Threshold (arena first look).
Round 1 build in — lighting, grade, ritual floor, living air.
Blind critic lane blocked (billing). Same unlabeled stills read here: the bar won.
NOT YET. Biggest gap: stock Kenney box with a ring on dirt vs an authored chamber (plate, carpets, furniture).
Round 2 in — seal plate, nave, side aisles, wall furniture, side braziers.
R2 still lost: tan dirt + HUD-reticle seal. Approach change — opaque plate, floor wash, no ticks.
Round 3 in — slate floor, gold seal + chevron, purple diamond rugs, graves/chest/table, wall windows.
Round 4 build — original bardo_room tileset. Kenney leaves the floor.
R4 recaptured: flagstones, purple runners, steel plate + chevron, tall planters, velvet benches, window lights.
Blind critic picked the bar. Gap: lighting pass over a brick-banner kit vs a furnished place with a signature inlay.
Round 5 in — still pool in the steel plate, ash-leaf planters, velvet armchairs. Banner kit stripped.
Round 6 in — aisles packed with plants, well-lip on the pool, hotter window lights. Critic on the still.
Blind critic still on the bar. Gap: tiled layout dressed with identical plants vs an interior with materials, motifs, a memorable center.
Round 7 in — star well + broken ring, three plant kinds, richer runners.
Blind critic still on the bar. Gap: schematic tiles and a graphic hole vs material weight, shadow, lived-in density.
Round 8 in — raised well lip, contact shadows under every prop. Still building.
Blind critic still on the bar. Gap: dim brick box + portal sticker vs furniture mass, contrasting materials, a thematic floor.
Round 9 in — 32px plants and chairs, wine runners, brass threshold inlay, north counters. Critic on the still.
Blind critic still on the bar. Gap: prefab lobby with a crest vs a furnished interior built around one architectural object.
Round 10 in — Keep-light walls, bigger steel plate, quieter door. Furniture can actually be named in the wide shot.
Blind critic still on the bar. Gap: tiled kit in bilateral symmetry, no lighting hierarchy, no authored monument.
Round 11 in — carved dais with relief threshold, restored vignette, slight furniture asymmetry.
Blind critic still on the bar. Gap: brick box of grid-snapped props and flat light vs materials, volume, a floor you remember.
STOP on arena-first-look after 11 rounds, 0 passes. Four audits agree the root cause is not the builder: no art direction to aim at, and a 60 Hz game judged on stills.
Verified all four audits against the live repo. 8 claims confirmed. 2 already stale: camera lookahead IS dt-corrected (camera.ts:24) and the gamepad deadzone IS already radial.
Struck the automated gate that demanded a 60-120s clear. Measured 37.8-43.3s. The only ways to pass were HP inflation or filler waves, both banned by the vision. Replaced with a variance gate.

Attack is now a true edge on keyboard, mouse and gamepad. Holding the button no longer plays the combo for you. Aim goes through the inverse world transform, so shake and zoom can no longer move your cursor.
Harness repaired: live metrics getter, widened state hash, visual/gameplay RNG split, pool-overflow telemetry, restart replay parity. 35 tests green, was 18.

The RNG split alone fixed the 'solved room'. kite/full clear spread 5.5s -> 8.9s; damage taken went from 4 on every seed to [2,4,1,3,3,3,4,2]. Zero variance was a coupling bug, not a wave-design problem.
pnpm strip ships: tick-labelled motion strips with state, events and freeze marked. Nine timing pieces went from unjudgeable to judgeable.
ART_DIRECTION.md ships, 533 lines with an acceptance test. The arena piece stays PARKED until it can be cited section by section instead of guessed at.
Caught a gate of my own that was as unmeasured as the one I struck: dodge success measured 0.03, not the asserted 0.6-0.8. Replaced with direct measurement of roll speed against run speed.
Found 29 Math.random calls in the render layer: the same strip captured twice differs. Giving presentation its own seeded generator, or every round-over-round diff is noise.
The Threshold stays PARKED (blocked on authored art). Next piece: the door. Walk north, wake in The Crossing.
The door works. Scenario run: open door, walk north, The Crossing loads. 38 tests green.
Blind critics (both orders) picked the bar. Gap: kit-on-a-grid vs a chamber with a floor thesis and light that carves volume. Same art block as The Threshold. Room graph stays; look is not a pass.
Run is now a real combat: Threshold wave sealed, door opens on clear, Crossing starts a different fight. Tests 39 green.
Strip t=435..675: ROOM CLEARED / WALK NORTH, walk through, Crossing WAVE 1, caster + two chargers spawn.
R2 critics split. One picked the sequence. The other named the gap: the north door still looks like the fight-state door; WALK NORTH is signage over a threshold that never opens.
Aperture pass: open door is a dark well with a gold sill, three tiles wide, light flood. Clear banner moved off the north wall so the door can be seen.
R2 critics (both orders) picked the sequence. Lit north hole, player in it, Crossing already in a fight. Not a room-beauty contest.
Next piece: two marked doors. Clear Threshold, choose north (fight) or east (quiet shore).
R1 both-order critics picked the bar. Gap: the choice lived in ROOM CLEARED / CHOOSE A DOOR and two matching floods, not in the doors.
R2: fat blade vs coin seals on the floor, ember vs gold light, toast then gone. Re-judge the settled frame.
R2 both-order critics still on the bar. Gap: path-promise icons — north tree reads, east is a lamp blob, HUD still owns the frame.
R3 both-order critics still on the bar. Gap moved to architecture: carved gates with living destination emblems, not neon slats plus stickers. PARK the look.
Door look parked. Next piece: the gift must pay. East door promised a gift; The Far Shore now holds a life vessel you walk into.

R1 critic BA picked the walk-to sequence (sixth flame, A LIFE RETURNS) but was not wowed. The bar pair was a combat still plus a heart icon — no take in frame. Swapped-order critic still out. No commit.
R1 critic AB picked the heart. Gap: token identity — the pedestal cone reads as a candle the banner has to name. R2: HUD life-cup at room scale; spent cup goes dark.
R2: one stamped HUD flame on a dark plate — the same silhouette as the life row, not a candle on furniture. Back to both-order critics.
R2 both orders picked the bar. Gap: life-token silhouette — the floor gift is a flame-on-black square the banner has to name. No commit.
R3: one ember heart on the floor, spent stamp goes cold iron. Same walk-in, HUD maxHp, banner. Back to both-order critics.
R3 both orders picked the bar. Gap: floor is a heart, readout is flames, banner still names the gift. No commit.
R4: one heart stamp for floor and life row. Dark well, no caption. Take is the pip count.
R4 both orders picked the walk-to heart (5 then 6). Wow: no. Gap: the floor mark is a HUD pip on a tile, not a sealed gift object. No commit.
R5: stone tablet, iron rim, recessed well, crimson inlay. Same heart as the life row. Sits; no bob, no caption.
R5 split. AB picked the bar (sealed vessel — ours still reads as a HUD pip). BA picked the walk-to. Wow: no. No commit.
R6: metal heart vessel — bone/iron rim, charcoal well, crimson stamp in the well. Same silhouette as the life row.
R6 both orders picked the bar. Gap: the well mark is a maroon V, not the orange HUD heart. No commit.
R7: HUD 7-wide heart stamped into the well, same cleft as the life row.
R7 split. AB: still a HUD pip. BA: beat lands, wow no. PARK the look — same family as the door seals. Mechanics stay; re-enter behind an authored token.
Next piece: the blessing bites. One modifier (cleave) changes reach, arc, and damage. No card screen.
R1 in — wider gold-amber crescent, +1 damage, HUD slash mark. Blind both-order critics on the contact still.
R1 both orders picked the bar. Gap: contact flash — gold crescent on an unchanged dummy. No wow. No commit.
R2: struck body goes wine, blessed hits use the heavy contact stamp, stepwise no longer skips the stamp. Back to critics.
R2 both orders picked the bar. Gap: the dummy wash reads as a red rectangle on the swing, not a body being cut. No commit.
R3: blessing on a brute, spaced so two silhouettes read. Contact stamp held through stepwise.
R3 split. AB picked ours (wow no). BA picked the bar — core/rim/afterimage and debris at the leading edge. PARK the look. Mechanics stay. Same family as the door seals.
Next piece: a second arm. Scenario bow, draw→loose→friendly arrow. Tests green. The blade still hits close; the bow does not melee.
R1 both orders picked the bar, wow on the winner. Gap: the loosed shot — a standing stamp and a one-pixel hair, not a body lunge, a flare, and a bolt that occupies space. No commit.
R2: thicker shaft, muzzle lobe, body pop on the loose. Recaptured the release, not the draw.
R2 both orders picked the bar. Same gap: the loose is a five-spark fan, not a lunging body and a glowing shot. PARK the look. Mechanics stay. Same family as the blessed smear.
Next piece: the first judge. Scenario boss, one warden: plant, radial slam, veil-break at half life. Tests green. Parked looks stay parked.
R1 both orders picked the bar, wow on the winner. Gap: the hood is player-height and upright inside a dotted ring. The smash has to live in a bigger body with the weapon already up. No commit.
R2: 1.85x mass, staff in the wind pose, gold rim only after commit. Recentered the still.

R2 both orders picked the bar, wow on the winner. Same gap: the smash has to live in a raised weapon and a body that fills the light, not a cloak and a floor ring. PARK the look. Mechanics stay. Re-enter only behind authored boss frames.
Next piece: death and return. You die, the card plays, R wakes you in The Bardo — not the same fight. A door starts the next attempt. Tests green. Parked looks stay parked.
R1 captured: death card (THE BARDO PULLS YOU BACK / RETURN) then standing in THE BARDO, alive, door open, no enemies. Blind against the house courtyard.
R1 both orders picked the bar, wow on the winner. Gap: the next-attempt door is a side prop; the title card is doing the return.
R2: banner gone, player facing the north opening. Same gap: a lamp-hole, not a monumental gate. Same family as the parked door seals.

R3 sequence (card then hub vs void then house) split, no wow either order. PARK the look. Mechanics stay: die, R, wake in The Bardo, door starts the next attempt. Re-enter only behind an authored gate and a death that leaves the fight.
Next piece: the hit lands. Light contact is 90% of the fight. Capture the stamp against a real melee still. Parked looks stay parked.
Hit-impact R1 (evidence r2): both orders picked the bar, no wow. Gap: a wound on the body and a flinch, not a white trail plus three sparks.
Hit-impact R2: freeze now holds the squash and wine tint; a pixel cut and floor stain sit on the wound; the body tips off the blade.

R2 both orders picked the bar, wow on the winner. Same family: a crumpled silhouette that keeps its outline, not a knot of flash. Two stalls. PARK. Re-enter behind an authored hit pose. Juice stays in the tree.
Next piece: the dodge roll. Authored 16px poses already in the tree. Motion strip against a real roll, not a painted still.
Dodge R1: split, no wow. AB liked our tumble and blue permission pulse; BA read a smear through a burst. Fair bar is Gungeon through-bullets, not an empty-room strip.

Dodge R2: both orders picked the bar. Through a brute slam the overlap reads as a hit — orange tell, yellow starburst, red wash. Stall 1. Same family: a body occupying a standing hazard, not a clash flash.

Dodge R3: roll through a bolt column, one dodged announce, no screen pulse. Split, wow on both winners. AB wants a flat dive the glow occludes; BA wants our cyan ring. Hold the dive through the beam next.

Dodge R4: dive held through occupy. Both orders picked the bar, wow on the winner. Same occupancy gap: a painted body the beam swallows, not a grey dive plus a ring. Two looks. PARK. Re-enter behind authored roll-through frames. Juice stays.
Next feel-lane piece: the sword swing. Parked looks stay parked. Do not grind the roll.
Sword-swing R1 captured: discrete light-light-heavy, heavy contact still vs a committed sword-cut still. Coil, embers, plant dust, crescent kept. Critics on the unlabeled boards.
Sword-swing R1: both orders picked the bar, wow on the winner. Gap: a lunging body and a glowing blade on a white-hot torn arc — not a cream ribbon painted over the fighter.
Sword-swing R2: smear under the fighters, hole around the body, hot tip in air, larger warm blade. Same bar. Critics on the unlabeled boards.

Sword-swing R2: both orders picked the bar, wow on the winner. Same family: an authored follow-through the crescent is the wake of, not a sticker on a 16px sprite. Two looks. PARK. Re-enter behind authored swing poses. Juice stays. Feel lane is parked. Next: the brute tell.
Brute tell R1: committed windup still vs a heavy melee windup. Floor pie already in the tree. HUD stripped. Critics on the unlabeled boards.
Brute R1: both orders picked ours, no wow. Gap: the pie is a stamp; the hammer has to author it. Idle bot was standing inside the brute.
Brute R2: player on the rim, taller coil, bigger hammer. Split — one order wowed by painted mass, the other picked our orange lane.
Brute R3: falling charge from hammer to landing bead. Split again. Next: cracks under the filled pie so the axe is glued to broken tiles.
Brute R4: cracks above the lightmap. Split on the same family. PARK. Keep-out pie stays. Re-enter behind authored brute frames. Next: the caster.
Caster bar locked: Sniper Shell aim still, not a Beholster density room. Solid 1px lock, player on the line.
Caster R1: both orders picked ours, no wow. The body is on the line. Gap they named was the bar's empty floor.
Caster R3: both orders picked the bar, wow. Hairline overlay vs a glowing sight from a scoped rifle.
Caster R4: split on the same family. PARK. Solid lock, stop-on-body, brighter sight, staff scale, detached bolt stay. Next: the charger.
Charger bar locked: a charge-lane telegraph still, not a density room. Judging the existing lock still.
Charger R1: both orders picked the bar. Rails + chevrons read as a HUD box, not a floor stain.
Charger R2: still a pasted rectangle. R3 bound the stain to the tiles. Same family. PARK.
Charger PARK. Tile stain, grout cuts, lock burst, dash wake stay. Next: the death card.
Death-card bar locked: Gungeon run-end killscreen (card vs card), not the House of Hades. Fight chrome now leaves when the stele owns the frame. Capturing the settled card.

Death-card R1: split. One order picked the stele (no wow). The other picked the bar. Same gap both ways: the page must show the last moment and name who sent you back. Not a pause menu. R2: stele beside the body; TAKEN BY on the stone.
Death-card R2 in. Stele left of the corpse, TAKEN BY THE HEAVY. Same killscreen bar. Critics on the unlabeled stills.
Death-card R2: both orders picked ours. No wow. Body still a leftover cloak. R3: wine well under the corpse.

Death-card R3: both orders picked ours again. Still no wow. Material/composition stuck at 3. PARK. Fight chrome off, left stele, TAKEN BY, wine well stay. Re-enter behind an authored fallen pose. Next: combat HUD.
Combat-HUD bar locked: mid-fight pixel HUD (hearts / resources / weapon), not a clean room. Judging the current fight chrome as-is. Spec defects (sim-clock banners, pad glyphs) already in the tree.
Combat-HUD R1: both orders picked the bar. Gap: countable icons and numbers, not WAVE 1/1 and unlabeled ticks. Do not invent a gun.
Combat-HUD R2: empty heart outlines and LEFT N. Both orders still picked the bar. Same family: a plated pistol and 42/330. We will not invent a gun.
Combat-HUD PARK. Two losses on weapon-and-ammo chrome. Empty outlines, LEFT N, mercy groove stay. Re-enter behind authored HUD stamps. Next: the audio bed.
Audio-bed R1 (structure, not taste): both critics named the same gap. Swing/dodge sit at ~0 dB over the bed in a live mix. Solo-over-bed is fine. R2: bed leans back 5 dB under a commit.
Audio-bed R2: crowd carve + delayed commit duck. Both critics still named player-commit lift. mix-hurt heavy −1.5 dB, mix dodge −0.6 dB.
Audio-bed PARK. Two losses on the same family. Buses, bed, announcer-off, crowd, lead stay. Re-enter behind authored combat stems.
Combat-feel pass off the audit (68/100). Verified every claim against HEAD first; two were worse in the code than in the write-up.
Trust fixes: keyboard aimed at the browser window corner (-142 deg for every direction, measured). Rolls were body-blocked mid-flight. Crowds squeezed bodies through walls on ordinary ticks.
Authority: reversal 167ms -> 100ms via a turn rate, not a shorter accel. Light contact 100ms -> 83ms. Steer correction 18 -> 36 deg. Hold-to-attack.
Bullet time on a perfect dodge: enemies gated inside stepWorld, player stays on 60Hz. Proven neutral - fixtures reproduce old hashes with only the trigger off.
Kill flash 0.35 -> 0.12; it was louder than getting hurt and washed out the next telegraph. 68 -> 107 tests. Enemy tuning is the open follow-up: kite clears in 28-33s vs a 60-120s target.
Truth pass in: seeds vary across reloads, the sim names the killer, 100/100 seeds reach home.
Parked CI template + manual browser smoke + acceptance matrix. The matrix immediately reported that mashing wins 2%.
The heavy is its own button. Ten contract tests; the neutral opener still coils 8px and throws 30.
Two powers, twelve vows, and fire. The offer screen has a face on it now.
Minos inherits the Warden mastery contract: taught slam, ring, and fan patterns with a safe half-life transition.
A title, held over the Bardo itself. The room breathes behind its own name.
The Oath-Bound turns light blades. Bot fell to 76%, learned the rule, came back to 91%.
Adversarial review found four real bugs, all mine, all silent. Fixed with regressions.
THE TOLL. The run's one beat of quiet: pay a vessel of life for a fourth vow, or cross owed and let Minos hear about it.

A 25-agent adversarial pass found ten real defects across the change set. All ten fixed: a boon that never fired, a shield that only half blocked, a boss that collapsed to one attack, two telegraphs that lied.

An external audit graded the branch 78 and was right: hashWorld's conditional writes were an aliasing machine (three reproduced collisions, now impossible), the matrix and smoke could pass on zero cases, and the smoke never rendered a frame over the screens it claimed to prove. All fixed; the smoke now boots the title with a real keypress.

An eight-angle code review of the controller-pause commit: the sealed doorway still glowed 'open' in two more renderers, the death-screen Start press paused the game on arrival, and damageTaken counted vessels the player never had. All eight findings fixed; doorOpens() is now the one place the open-door rule lives.

Plan of record refreshed at 6852aa0 (Revision 3): the PR loop is the standing directive, the gauntlet is retired with a disposition on every parked piece, the PixelLab cycle deliberately lapses, and the remainder runs as PRs 1-7. Phase 0 begins: death-card build + beat, volume sliders, abandon, pad pause, reward prompt fixes, playtest build.

Phase 0 shipped in four commits: the pause card is an operable pad-ready menu (volume sliders on a schema-3 save, held abandon), the death stele carries the weapon and vows behind a minimum reveal beat, and ?playtest= arms recorded sessions with verb conditions and an F4 bundle that replays headlessly. 524 tests, hashes byte-identical, matrix 100/100 (kite 70%, naive 0%), smoke both endings, build 2.0 MB.

An eight-angle adversarial review of Phase 0 found ten findings; eight fixed, two investigated and rejected with evidence. The worst was a seam the tests could not see: the shell pause stops sample(), so the Enter that chose RESUME was still latched and confirmed the boon offer underneath. Also fixed: a held pad A could never open the pause card, abandon and playtest recording were mutually incoherent (now interlocked), the schema bump had broken the desktop smoke, and the master slider answered on a different loudness curve than the two beside it.

pieces.name: The blade commits
pieces.title: Feel lane 1/3 — anticipation, arc, contact, a heavy that plants
pieces.blurb: Three discrete presses. The crescent stays. The third hit plants. The still loses to a painted lunge.
pieces.gap: Authored follow-through: a body and a physical blade the crescent is the wake of. Two still rounds lost on the same family. Re-enter behind painted swing poses. Under-fighter smear, hole, hot tip, and warm heavy blade stay.

pieces.name: The hit lands
pieces.title: Light contact: freeze, wound, flinch, camera
pieces.blurb: Ninety percent of swings are light. The camera moves, the body tips, a cut sits on the wound. The still still loses to a painted crumple.
pieces.gap: Authored hit pose: a crumpled silhouette that keeps its outline, plus a wound burst on flesh. Two still rounds lost on the same gap. Re-enter behind painted contact frames. Freeze-hold, flinch, and the pixel cut stay in the tree.

pieces.name: The roll
pieces.title: Launch, through, plant. Authored 16px poses.
pieces.blurb: A bolt column you can occupy, one permission ring, no slam flash. The still loses to a painted body the beam swallows.
pieces.gap: Authored roll-through: a tumbling silhouette the hazard bloom swallows, plus plant dust. Two occupancy rounds lost after the slam-as-hit exhibit was retired. Re-enter behind painted through-frames. Dive-through-occupy, one-shot dodged, and no screen pulse stay.

pieces.name: Get out of the red
pieces.title: The brute tell is geometry, not a shared hue
pieces.blurb: Chase, plant, committed lunge, a long punish. A pie on the floor says where the hammer lands.
pieces.gap: Authored windup mass: a body that can break the stone. Four looks — one pick-win, three splits on painted giant vs keep-out pie. Same family as the warden. Re-enter behind painted brute frames. The pie, charge, bead, and cracks stay.

pieces.name: Cross the line or cut the bolt
pieces.title: A searching aim that hardens, a bolt you can cut
pieces.blurb: Range, a dotted line that locks, one cuttable bolt. The sentence has to read before the shot leaves.
pieces.gap: Authored staff and a fat sight that owns the floor. Four looks: pick-win, split, loss, split. Thick reads as a hit; thin reads as overlay. Re-enter behind painted caster frames. Solid lock, stop-on-body, brighter sight, staff scale, detached bolt stay.

pieces.name: Count the tremble
pieces.title: A freeze, a lane, a dash you can step off
pieces.blurb: Orbit, a planted tremble, one committed dash. Four chargers cannot read as four identical blinks.
pieces.bar: Dash-lane telegraph still (not a density room)
pieces.gap: Painted floor wound that grows out of the body. Rails, stain-quad, and tile fills all read as a pasted rectangle. Re-enter behind authored stone. Tile stain, grout, lock burst, dash wake stay.

pieces.name: The fight chrome
pieces.title: Hearts, wave, place name — the inhabited combat frame
pieces.blurb: During a fight the corners tell you if you are dying and how many are left. The middle stays the fight.
pieces.bar: Mid-fight pixel HUD (not a clean room)
pieces.gap: Authored HUD stamps: hearts plus a blade that is ours. Two losses on Gungeon weapon-and-ammo chrome. We will not invent a gun. Empty outlines, LEFT N, mercy groove stay.

pieces.name: Not yet reborn
pieces.title: The run ends; a stele names the pull back
pieces.blurb: You are already dead. Losing a run is being pulled back to the bardo, not a game over. The card is the threshold: a star-sky arch, a tally, a way back.
pieces.bar: Gungeon run-end death page (not a hub room)
pieces.gap: Authored fallen pose and a carved stele. Two no-wow wins after a split; Graphics plaque over a standing heap. Fight chrome off, left stele, TAKEN BY, wine well, star-sky arch stay.

pieces.name: The floor of sound
pieces.title: A bed under the fight, buses that can grow
pieces.blurb: The room has a drone. The fight has a second layer. Foley rides its own bus. No image can judge this.
pieces.bar: Structure and levels, not a still
pieces.gap: Authored combat stems and recorded swing takes. Two losses on player-commit lift in a stacked mix. Buses, bed, announcer-off, crowd, lead stay.

pieces.title: PARKED after 11 losses. Re-enters only behind the art bible and an authored asset kit.
pieces.name: The Threshold
The door
pieces.title: Clear the room, walk the open door, fight in the next chamber
pieces.blurb: A run is a lie until the last kill opens a door you walk through into a new fight.

pieces.name: Two doors
pieces.title: Clear the room, two marked exits, commit to a fight or a quiet shore
pieces.blurb: A run is a choice. After the last kill, two doors light: one marked for combat, one for a gift. You walk one.
pieces.gap: Carved exit gates with living destination emblems. Three rounds of TypeScript seals lost; same family as The Threshold. Re-enter only behind authored door art.

pieces.name: A life returns
pieces.title: Walk the gift door, take a vessel, gain a life
pieces.blurb: The east door promised a gift. The Far Shore pays: a heart on the floor you walk into, and a sixth life.
pieces.gap: Authored sealed life token (rim, well, stamp with mass). Seven rounds of TypeScript hearts lost or split; same family as The Threshold and the door seals. Re-enter only behind authored token art.

pieces.name: The blessing bites
pieces.title: One modifier changes how the blade cuts
pieces.blurb: A single blessing on the sword: longer reach, a wider hotter arc, a harder hit. The room plays differently. No card screen this piece.
pieces.gap: Authored layered cut: core, rim, afterimage, and debris through a body. Three rounds of a TypeScript smear lost or split; same family as The Threshold. Re-enter behind authored slash art.

pieces.name: The string is taut
pieces.title: A second weapon: draw, loose, an arrow that hits past the blade
pieces.blurb: The player controller is a weapon system. Scenario bow starts already armed. One press draws, looses a friendly arrow, hits at a range the sword cannot. No weapon-select UI.
pieces.gap: Authored release: a lunging body, a glowing shot with mass, and light on the stone. Two rounds of a TypeScript fan lost; same family as the blessed smear. Re-enter behind authored bow and arrow art.

pieces.name: The first judge
pieces.title: One boss: a plant, a radial slam, the veil breaks at half life
pieces.blurb: The room has a judge. A long windup, a slam you can walk out of, a long punish. At half life the next slam throws a ring of bolts. Named bar. Scenario boss.
pieces.gap: Authored windup: a body whose raised weapon and mass are the tell. Two rounds of a scaled hood and a floor ring lost on the same gap. Re-enter only behind painted boss frames.

pieces.name: Not yet reborn
pieces.title: Death pulls you back to The Bardo; a door starts the next attempt
pieces.blurb: A run is one attempt. Dying is not a restart of the same fight. The card plays, you press R, you wake in a named quiet place with a door out.
pieces.gap: Authored attempt gate and a death that leaves the fight (a body, not a form over a stance). Two still rounds lost on the same door-look as Two doors; sequence split with no wow. Re-enter only behind authored hub art.
